The powerful beam rapidly germinates the seed, applying stacks of Light-Gorged. After 8 sec, the blossom casts Lightbloom Overgrowth.Standing within the beam stifles the seed's growth and prevents applications of Light-Gorged.

rows.description: 卡莉斯对一名玩家造成116379点暗影伤害。

rows.description: 无眠之心以注风箭矢标记玩家。经过6秒后，箭矢释放出狂风，对8码内的玩家造成87284点自然伤害，此后每1秒造成26670点自然伤害，持续8秒。狂风会摧毁任何击中的风暴灵魂之泉。
rows.descriptionEn: The Restless Heart marks players with wind-infused arrows. After 6 sec, the arrows unleash a wind gust, inflicting 87284 Nature damage to players within 8 yards and an additional 26670 Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.The wind gust destroys any Storming Soulfont hit.

rows.description: 当无眠之心跃起时，风暴能量会向四周呼啸而出，对所有玩家造成87284点自然伤害，此后每1秒额外造成21821点自然伤害。接触湍急箭矢可移除此效果。
rows.descriptionEn: Stormy energy lashes outward when the Restless Heart leaps, inflicting 87284 Nature damage to all players and an additional 21821 Nature damage every 1 sec.Contacting Turbulent Arrows removes this affliction.

rows.description: 炽焰腾流造成242456点火焰伤害，并将玩家抛向高空。
rows.descriptionEn: Flaming Updraft inflicts 242456 Fire damage, and throws players up into the air.

rows.description: 烈焰残迹每1.5秒对其中的玩家造成145474点火焰伤害。区域中央的炽焰腾流会对接触的玩家造成242456点火焰伤害并将其击退。
rows.descriptionEn: Fiery remains inflict 145474 Fire damage every 1.5 sec to players within. The patch's central updraft inflicts inflicts 242456 Fire damage to players who touch it, knocking them away.

rows.description: 点燃余烬对来自燃烧烈风的风做出反应，喷射出火焰飓风，对击中的玩家造成242456点火焰伤害并使其昏迷2秒，随后将其抛飞。
rows.descriptionEn: Ignited Embers react to the winds from Burning Gale, ejecting fiery tornadoes that inflict 242456 Fire damage to players struck and stun players hit for 2 sec before tossing them away.

rows.description: 施法者对当前目标造成物理伤害。
rows.descriptionEn: The caster inflicts Physical damage to its current target

rows.description: 恼人的步兵朝其当前目标冲锋，造成116379点物理伤害。
rows.descriptionEn: The Haunting Grunt charges toward their current target and inflicts 116379 Physical damage.
